summary: Base, the Coinbase-backed Ethereum L2, has put Apple, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon onchain as tokenized stocks, pushing the tokenized equities market to $3.84B despite pushback from issuers. This marks a milestone in bringing mega-cap public equities onchain and positions Base as a leading venue for tokenized stocks. It matters because it signals accelerating convergence of traditional equity markets with onchain finance, while issuer resistance highlights regulatory and corporate friction ahead.
